en.headline: 405 own commits and 715 automated ones across 11 repos, plus 34 issue actions
en.teaser: Most work went into the daily-summary pipeline, an OpenCode sandbox and skill tooling, a translation extension and a pixel-logo CLI, with four releases of the model picker.
en.overview:
### Own projects

Most of the window went into the daily-summary repository, where the AI narrative layer was reworked: the duplicate empty-day gate was removed, blank days no longer swallow discussion sections, truncation is now flagged when collection hits its cap, and commit attribution accepts aliases so non-GitHub emails are counted. A 30-day GitHub activity AI summary was added as a home-page card and a standalone page, and the CLI gained a `--force` flag that skips the frozen comment-count snapshot and re-fetches it for finalized days. Candidate items are no longer filtered by whether `updated_at` falls inside the window.

A second large thread was OpenCode tooling. The agent-sandbox repository collected knowledge notes on OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, authentication, Windows path pitfalls and remote-branch deletion risks, and generalized its knowledge base beyond Git and GitHub. The skill-management repository implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, moved plans into `.openchamber/plans`, normalized line endings to LF, and shipped rc.0, rc.1, 0.2.0, 1.0.0, 1.1.0 and 1.2.0, the last turning all four actions into validated JSON output.

The model picker reached 1.4.0, 2.0.0, 3.0.0 and 3.0.1. Work covered shared JSON and proxy helpers, fuller agent discovery with skipped built-ins reported, atomic snapshot writes, a bias that is never restamped with today's date, a version badge derived from `SKILL.md`, and a large documentation reduction in 3.0.0.

### Other own repositories

`sopen-translate` was started from scratch as an MV3 extension: page translation with bilingual rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and progress reporting, a provider protocol layer with presets, model lists and a glossary pipeline, JSDoc type checking, and a refactor that dropped selection translation. `pixel-logo-toolkit` gained automatic text wrapping with overflow protection, a bilingual CLI, an English-first README with a Chinese version, a 40-image command gallery, a Korean font fix and two releases. `dsh-ecosystem-report` got mobile viewport fixes, a single-button theme menu, visual refinements and three added plugins. `asset-inventory` shipped v1.15.4 and v1.15.5 with corrected skill-invocation facts, and `myBlog` added OpenChamber capture samples.

### Upstream issue work

Outside own repositories, 16 issue actions went to openchamber and 11 to anomalyco/opencode, mostly bug reports on session retention hints, MCP settings, quote-card navigation, file-view commenting, context-panel breakdowns, capture resolution and agent linking, plus OpenCode Go image-input and subagent model errors. One issue was opened on microsoft/PowerToys about a Shortcut Guide NullReferenceException. Eight discussions were started in openchamber's Ideas category.

### Totals

Across the window there were 405 own commits plus 715 automated commits, 0 pull requests and 0 reviews, and 34 issue actions. No days in the window are missing data.

zh.headline: 11 个仓库共 405 次本人提交、715 次自动提交，另有 34 次 issue 互动
zh.teaser: 主要工作集中在日报流水线、OpenCode 沙箱与 skill 工具、翻译扩展和像素 Logo 命令行工具，模型选择器发布了四个版本。
zh.overview:
### 自有仓库

本窗口大部分精力投入日报仓库：重做了 AI 叙述层，去掉重复的空白天拦截，空白天不再吞掉 discussion 等附加段，采集命中上限时会在日报与摘要中标注截断，提交归属支持别名以兼容非 GitHub 邮箱。新增近 30 天 GitHub 活动 AI 总结，包含首页卡片与独立页；CLI 增加 `--force`，可跳过评论数快照冻结并重取定稿日期的快照；候选条目不再按 `updated_at` 是否落在窗口内过滤。

第二条主线是 OpenCode 工具链。agent-sandbox 仓库归档了 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构、认证与 Windows 路径坑，以及远程分支删除的风险，并把知识库从 Git/GitHub 泛化为各种知识。skill-management 仓库实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，计划迁到 `.openchamber/plans`，换行符统一为 LF，并连续发布 0.2.0、1.0.0、1.1.0 和 1.2.0，最后一版把四个动作改为带校验的 JSON 输出。

模型选择器发布了 1.4.0、2.0.0、3.0.0 和 3.0.1：加入共享的 JSON 与代理辅助脚本，补全 agent 发现并报告被跳过的内置项，快照改为原子写入，旧偏差不再被盖上当天日期，版本徽章改为从 `SKILL.md` 推导，3.0.0 大幅压缩了文档体积。

### 其他自有仓库

`sopen-translate` 从零搭起 MV3 扩展：页面翻译与双语渲染、分块、熔断与进度、带预设和术语表的协议层、JSDoc 类型检查，并重构去掉了划词翻译。`pixel-logo-toolkit` 增加文本自动折行与溢出保护、中英双语命令行、英文优先的 README 与中文版、40 张命令示例画廊、韩语字体修正，并发布两个版本。`dsh-ecosystem-report` 修复 375/414 移动视口，主题切换改为单按钮菜单，做视觉精修并并入三个插件。`asset-inventory` 发布 v1.15.4 与 v1.15.5，修正 skill 调用方式；`myBlog` 补充了 OpenChamber 截图样例。

### 上游 issue 互动

自有仓库之外，openchamber 有 16 次 issue 互动，anomalyco/opencode 有 11 次，主要是关于会话保留提示、MCP 设置、引用卡片跳转、文件视图评论、上下文面板占比、截图分辨率与 agent 关联的缺陷报告，以及 OpenCode Go 图片输入和子代理模型报错。另在 microsoft/PowerToys 提了一个 Shortcut Guide 空引用异常问题，并在 openchamber 的 Ideas 分类发起 8 个讨论。

### 总计

整个窗口共有 405 次本人提交，另有 715 次自动提交，0 个 PR、0 次评审、34 次 issue 互动。窗口内没有缺失数据的日期。

highlights.text: 在 AI 叙述生成失败的问题下留言。
新开、评论并关闭了一个临时的 opencode /oc 冒烟测试 issue。
v1.0.0 将 skill_management 的接口在 1.x 内冻结。
3.0.0 把模型需要阅读的文档从约 27,400 token 降到约 2,200 token。
v0.3.0 加入文本自动折行与溢出保护。
报告设置中的 MCP 页面漏掉 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务。
新开并关闭了 Go 端点拒绝 mimo 模型所宣称图片输入的问题。
提交了 Shortcut Guide 按住 Win 激活时空引用异常的问题。
